@graph.name: Hollywood Facial
@graph.description: Visit Derma Solutions - Best Hollywood Facial - Carbon Peel Treatment in Bangalore. Safe, Affordable, and Advanced Laser treatments. Book Your Appointment Today
@graph.howPerformed: First, a thin layer of carbon solution is applied, which absorbs oil, dirt and impurities from deep within the pores. A specialized laser is then passed over the skin, vaporizing the carbon along with dead skin and excess oil. The heat this generates stimulates collagen, leaving skin smoother, brighter and rejuvenated.

mainEntity.name: Is the Hollywood Facial safe for all skin types?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is safe and effective for most skin types, including sensitive skin, when your dermatologist customizes the laser settings.

mainEntity.name: How soon will I see results after a Hollywood Facial?

acceptedAnswer.text: You'll notice smoother, brighter skin right after the first session. For lasting results and deeper concerns, multiple sessions may be recommended.

mainEntity.name: How often should I get a Hollywood Facial?

acceptedAnswer.text: For best results, we recommend a session every 4–6 weeks. Each session typically lasts 30–45 minutes.

mainEntity.name: What care is needed after the treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: There's no downtime. Apply sunscreen daily, avoid heavy makeup for 24 hours, and follow your dermatologist's aftercare advice.
